result.reason: Transmitting the qrsig-derived authentication token to a remote server contradicts the stated local-only handling of credentials.
Unredacted credentials are printed to standard output, but no unintended audience is established. A disclosure harm would depend on unspecified downstream capture or access.
Sending authentication cookies to the remote album-list endpoint breaks the stated promise that credentials are never uploaded to a server.
The hardcoded public-visibility setting requests broader access to the album without an established user choice authorizing public sharing; successful publication is not established.
The explicit private-comment request probes for confidential content beyond the authorized photo-browsing or backup purpose; actual receipt is not established.
Explicitly transmitting p_skey and skey in upload form fields contradicts the stated local-only handling of authentication secrets.
